column1: # Golden envelopes every runtime must reproduce byte for byte.
# One case per line. Fields are tab separated `key=value` pairs, so all three
# languages can read them without a JSON parser -- the Rust crate stays
# dependency-free -- and an optional field is simply absent rather than an empty
# column somebody has to count. Only the first `=` separates; values may contain
# more, which is why `expected` can be JSON.
# Keys: name, failure_point, code, service, impact, detail,
# The cases are real: every one is a failure this fleet produced while the
# vocabulary lived in six copies and the gateway had none.
